command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- OS ---'
cat /etc/os-release
uname -r
printf '%s\n' '--- identity/access ---'
id
printf '%s\n' '--- packages/tools ---'
command -v lvm || true
command -v pvcreate || true
command -v lsblk || true
rpm -q lvm2 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- block/storage ---'
lsblk -o NAME,PATH,SIZE,TYPE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINTS,UUID
printf '%s\n' '--- LVM ---'
pvs 2>&1 || true
vgs 2>&1 || true
lvs -a -o lv_name,vg_name,lv_size,lv_path,lv_attr,devices 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- mounts/fstab ---'
findmnt -R / 2>&1 || true
cat /etc/fstab

systemctl --failed --no-pager 2>&1 || true
ss -tlnp 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- boot ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
